goal: Build a customer-facing LIFF staging surface for submitting a two-meal reschedule request for nutritionist/admin approval.

policy.target_window: from package expiry date through expiry date plus 30 calendar days inclusive

required_acceptance: server verifies owner/order authority server-side; never trusts client UID
preview is read-only and cancel creates no request
submit is idempotent and creates pending_admin request
target window and occupied target rejection are tested
mobile and desktop UI show source/target dates and lunch+dinner together
no production, LINE, Railway, Sheets, or external API access during tests
